pages.text: The Celestial Anvil supports advanced equipment combining without the vanilla Too Expensive cap. Valid operations cost at least one level, rounded up from half the normal level cost. Equip in slot 6 for portable access.

pages.title: Inscription Ingredients
pages.text: The Inscription tab names one item using a Feather. Place the item in ITEM, a Feather in FEATHER, and optionally a Dye in DYE and one style ingredient in STYLE. Choose Default or Uniform with the Font button. Uniform changes the Minecraft font, not the style ingredient.

pages.title: Style Ingredient Chart
pages.text: STYLE slot recipes: $(br)- Glow Ink Sac = Bold$(br)- Blue Orchid = Italic$(br)- String = Underlined$(br)- Iron Sword = Strikethrough$(br)- Skeleton Skull = Obfuscated$(br)- Wither Skeleton Skull = Obfuscated$(br)- Zombie, Creeper, Dragon, Piglin or Player Head = Obfuscated

pages.title: Color and Cost
pages.text: Any vanilla dye in DYE colors the inscription. A style ingredient is optional; leave STYLE empty for ordinary text. The Feather is required and consumed. Naming costs XP, with an additional cost for each optional dye/style offering. The inscription tab applies one style ingredient at a time; it does not combine several STYLE items.
